samples.description: Firm-year observations for 1964–1993 with prior, current and subsequent annual accounting records and CRSP monthly price/share availability at each fiscal-year anchor, currency-coherent constructions, documented unclassified-balance-sheet exclusion, and observed goodwill-increase exclusion. The voluntary-accounting-change footnote screen is unavailable in the selected source fields.

assumptions: Within-year annual cross-sectional estimator is unweighted OLS with an intercept, as the paper does not name the estimator or report additional effects or covariance adjustments.
Current data vintage replaces the paper's Compustat 2000 and CRSP 2001 versions.

The paper's physical PDF p. 5 wording supports CRSP price/share availability at prior, current, and subsequent fiscal-year anchors; the exact month-end selection rule is unspecified and implemented as the latest available month-end within 31 days before each DATADATE.
The voluntary-accounting-change footnote screen is unavailable in the selected local fields, and the source's numeric goodwill item crosswalk remains unresolved; see design.md.

limitations: The final sample is 59,614 versus 32,961 in the paper. The source-supported three-period CRSP screen reduces the predecessor's 67,346 to 59,614, but current data vintage alone is not established as the cause of the remaining gap.
Compustat ACCTCHG is blank in the selected annual records and item-level footnotes needed for the voluntary-accounting-change exclusion are unavailable.

The paper calls its goodwill screen legacy item 240; the current 2004 guide maps annual item A240 to LIFR, so GDWL is used by semantic label as a best-effort proxy and the historical crosswalk is unresolved.
The paper does not specify the exact monthly CRSP price/share date rule; the nearest prior month-end within 31 days is a documented best-effort interpretation.
